summary: Nippon Ichi's gridless tactical RPG series, beginning with Phantom Brave and continuing with The Lost Hero.

entries.title: Phantom Brave
entries.definitive_edition: Phantom Brave PC / The Hermuda Triangle Remastered content route

emulation.notes: Use PC for the main run; emulate PS2/Wii/PSP only for historical comparison.

primary.version: Phantom Brave PC / The Hermuda Triangle Remastered content route
primary.why: The PC version is documented as including all added content from the Wii and PSP versions, making it the best blend of completeness and capture flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam/PC release; use the PS5 or Switch rereleases only if console capture is preferred.

entries.remaster_caveats: Multiple rereleases exist; verify exact naming on storefront because PC and console packages vary.

entries.title: Phantom Brave: The Lost Hero

emulation.notes: Use the PC release for the main run.

primary.why: The Lost Hero released on PS4, PS5, Switch, and later Windows; PC is the highest-fidelity and most flexible capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release with current patches; use PS5 only if console capture is preferred.

entries.remaster_caveats: Sequel, not a remake of the original Phantom Brave.
